summary.ko: 추가 요청을 기존 범위와 비교해 일정·비용·품질 영향과 선택지를 정리합니다.
summary.en: Compare a change request with the approved baseline and explain scope, cost, and schedule trade-offs.

exclusions: Initial project estimation without a baseline

required_inputs.description: Current approved scope, schedule, and relevant assumptions
Exact new request and any priority or deadline constraints

workflow.instruction: Identify what is genuinely new, changed, removed, or already included in the baseline.
Trace the effect on deliverables, dependencies, completed work, review rounds, and acceptance criteria.
Estimate impact using available evidence and present bounded options such as swap, extend, or defer.
Draft a decision note that states what remains unchanged and what needs user or client approval.

deliverables.name: Change impact note
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Includes baseline comparison, effects, assumptions, options, and approval questions

limitations: Do not call a request out of scope without checking the baseline.
Cost and schedule impacts remain estimates until approved.
permission_boundaries: Do not accept the change, revise a contract, promise dates, or send a client response.
Do not delete completed work or modify billing based on an unapproved request.
